plan.title: A dark, flash-lit bedtime selfie with no bed in shot counts

context.text: Night 2 locked in, Yanni. Same deal tonight: in bed, phone down by 9:45, selfie with the lights off.

transcript.text: [photo dark-selfie.jpg: a dark, flash-lit selfie of the tester squinting at the flash, shirt off, dark room; no bed visible in the shot] phone's going down 😴
Day 3 in the books, Yanni 😴 That squint says the flash got you good. How did it feel tonight, was it easy to put the phone down, or did you have to fight it?

checks.reason: Counts the photo as done but spends the text on the squint and asks how it felt, not a short celebration of night 3.
Two sentences with one question at the end.
Warm, playful energy with an emoji as punctuation, no suspicion.
Reacts to the squint and flash in the photo, which is what the image shows.

conversation.reason: Counts night 3 and doesn't question the photo, but the reply runs into a reflection question rather than a one-or-two-sentence celebration.

grade.summary: ZOH accepted the dark, flash-lit selfie as proof and counted night 3 without questioning it, and kept the voice warm and short. It went a bit beyond the brief by turning straight to a feelings question, when a quick celebration would have fit the regression case better.
